people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
translations.bsb: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening to take his stand.
translations.kjv: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
translations.asv: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
